entities.summary: Ostrzeszów is a town in south-central Poland, in Greater Poland Voivodeship. It is the capital of Ostrzeszów County. Ostrzeszów is located in the historical Wieluń Land. The population in 2023 was 14,095 inhabitants. The town is situated around 80 kilometres from Wrocław, 170 km from Katowice and 160 km from Poznań.
